verdict.rationale: Rootly's own docs describe Alert Deduplication: repeat events from the same monitor collapse onto a single open alert using a stable identifier, so the responder sees a climbing count instead of being paged again. The alerts overview also states that Rootly groups related alerts together before routing. missing for 10: detailed documentation of how related (non-identical) alerts are grouped into one incident or page, independent or hands-on corroboration of dedup and grouping behavior.
